mechanism: Torsemide causes systemic volume depletion and hypotension, which may be additive with brimonidine's alpha-2 agonist effects that can lower blood pressure, particularly with topical absorption.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly in patients using both agents; brimonidine ophthalmic has minimal systemic absorption but caution is warranted in patients on diuretics with hypovolemia or hypotension.
